name: session-create-device-login-unacknowledged-409

graded_by.test: core/internal/httpapi/device_login_test.go — TestAPromptLoginThatWouldBeRecordedNeedsConsent: 409 while the knob is on and the login lacks recording_acknowledged; 202 once it is set; nothing placed on the 409

description: A prompt-mode login is a login: while `GET /auth/me` says `recording.login_input` is true, the user name, the device's prompt text and every answer would be recorded, and a create that does not set `login.recording_acknowledged` true is 409 `login_recording_not_acknowledged` before anything is placed or dialled (session-open step 2b). The surface re-reads `/auth/me`, warns the operator before it asks `login as:`, and repeats the request with the field true. A run cannot control the deployment's knob, so only the core's own test grades this.

error.message: the login would be recorded; acknowledge the recording and repeat the request
